next_step: Ship EU-hosted POC checklist; pricing for 3-month Dedicated pilot
notes:
Account snapshot and recent activity:
- Company: Ivory Delta Systems — mid-market B2B product suite (customer onboarding + knowledge base). EU HQ (Berlin).
- Primary sponsor: CTO Nina Vogel; Product lead: Tomas Erikson. AE: Maya Patel; SE: Luca Moretti.
- Stage: evaluating Hosted API for quick time-to-value, with plan to move to Dedicated if performance/residency check passes.

Timeline / interactions:
- 2026-02-08: Intro call (owner: Maya). High-level product fit: chat-based support agent + doc search for enterprise customers.
- 2026-02-18: Hosted API demo + live prompt walkthrough (ff-20260218-ivd-demo-01). Team ran canonical support flows; latency felt OK for dev region but concerned about EU p50/p95.
- 2026-02-22: Security questionnaire submitted — SOC2 + SSO required, asked for KMS options and audit log retention.
- 2026-02-28: Pricing follow-up email; asked for 3-month Dedicated pilot numbers and overage policy (thread:1734f-ivd-hosted-demo).
- 2026-03-04: SE workshop — discussed batching, caching, and model quantization to reduce token cost. SE recommended Redwood Optimize suggestions for reranking and embeddings.
- 2026-03-08: Internal legal flagged data residency: "we cannot send PII outside EU for our EU customers" (quote from CTO Nina). Legal asked for region guarantee and contractual residency clause.

Technical / requirements summary:
- Workloads: chat (session-based), embeddings for semantic search, light reranking for support prioritization.
- Latency targets: p50 < 120ms EU region for short chat turns; p95 < 400ms acceptable for longer responses. Throughput: 60 concurrent sessions per region initially, plan to scale to 300.
- Data residency: must keep EU-customer input and logs inside EU region; metadata OK to replicate for analytics only if anonymized.
- Multi-region routing: want primary EU region, fallback to NA only for non-PII requests. Interested in per-customer routing policies and sticky routing for session locality.
- Model preferences: prefer open models (licensed) for cost control; open to Redwood-curated LLM variants. Need guidance on quantization tradeoffs vs. quality.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for crypto keys, SOC2 compliance evidence and vendor pen-test report.

POC scope (requested):
- 2-week Hosted API POC in eu-west region using dev dataset (synthetic PII masked). Goal: validate latency p50/p95, embedding quality for search, model routing logic.
- If Hosted POC passes, 3-month Dedicated pilot in eu-central with single GPU pool, reserved throughput, SLA section in contract. Cost estimate + setup guide needed.

Commercial notes:
- Price sensitivity: mid-market procurement; wants line-item Dedicated pilot pricing and monthly burn estimate. Emphasize unit economics (cost/token + expected batching gains).
- Procurement timeline: Legal + Security review expected 3-4 weeks post POC. Forecast customer decision target: 2026-04.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal needs a residency clause and explicit confirmation that customer data (including KV cache) will not leave EU for their EU customers.
- Network: need L3 peering/VPN details for Dedicated in eu-central; they want simple setup docs.
- Cost: need a worked example for 60->300 sessions with batching applied; show Dedicated vs. Hosted cost delta.

Rep from Ivory Delta (CTO): "We like the UX of Hosted for trials but cannot compromise on EU-only residency for customer data — that is non-negotiable for enterprise deals."

Actions agreed / next steps:
- SE (Luca) to deliver Hosted POC checklist + EU region performance baseline by 2026-03-12.
- AE (Maya) to share Dedicated pilot pricing sheet and contract residency language draft by 2026-03-15 (drive:/sales/decks/ivory-delta/redwood-pricing-2026-03.pdf).
- Security: schedule vendor security call (include security engineer) week of 2026-03-16.
- Blocker resolution: Legal to review draft residency clause; if accepted, proceed to Dedicated pilot procurement.

CRM style quick notes:
- Short: "Host first -> move to Dedicated after residency OK".
- Phrases heard: "EU-only for PII", "want sticky EU routing", "need clear Dedicated pilot price".
- Internal stance: product team enthusiastic; procurement cautious (budget cadence April).

Relevant artifacts: pricing pdf, security FAQ, Fireflies transcript.
additional_context: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Hosted then Dedicated with emphasis on EU data residency, multi-region routing and latency tradeoffs. Keep follow-ups tight; legal is main gating factor.
